Task.title: Task
Task.description: Represents a task or business opportunity within the TaskMaster Pro application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Task entity.

title.description: The title or name of the task or business opportunity.

client.description: The client or company associated with the task.

value.description: The estimated value or potential revenue of the task.

probability.description: The probability of success for the task, expressed as a percentage.

dueDate.description: The date by which the task should be completed.

status.description: The current status of the task (e.g., backlog, prospecting, negotiation, closing, done).

priority.description: The priority level of the task (e.g., low, medium, high).

delegateTo.description: The person to whom the task is delegated.

description.description: A detailed description of the task.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the TaskMaster Pro application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: The email address of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

phone.description: The phone number of the user.

ownerId.description: The UID of the team owner who invited this user. Establishes the member-to-owner relationship.

Prospect.title: Prospect
Prospect.description: Represents a business prospect or lead.

value.description: The estimated value of the business opportunity.

probability.description: The probability of closing the deal, as a percentage.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: Represents a chat conversation between two or more users.

memberIds.description: Array of user UIDs participating in the chat.

lastMessageTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last message sent in the chat.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a single message within a chat.

senderId.description: The UID of the user who sent the message.

text.description: The text content of the message.

mediaUrl.description: URL of any media attached to the message.

timestamp.description: The time the message was sent.

readBy.description: Array of user UIDs who have read the message.

Investor.title: Investor
Investor.description: Represents an investor and their primary investment details.

investmentTerm.description: The term of the investment in months (e.g., 6, 12, 24).

status.description: Current status of the investment (e.g., Active, Liquidated).

paymentType.description: The payment scheme for the investment interest.

monthlyPaymentDay.description: The day of the month for monthly interest payments (1-31). Calculated automatically from investmentDate.

liquidationDate.description: The date for the final lump sum payment (capital + interest). Calculated automatically from investmentDate and investmentTerm.

InvestmentTransaction.title: InvestmentTransaction
InvestmentTransaction.description: Represents a single transaction related to an investment.

description.description: Notes or details about the transaction.

attachments.description: Array of evidence files attached to the transaction.

dueDate.description: The specific due date of the interest payment for a given month.

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: Represents a bank account with its details and balance.

companyName.description: Name of the company or entity that owns the account.

bankName.description: Name of the bank (e.g., BBVA, Santander).

initialBalance.description: The initial balance amount at a specific date.

balanceDate.description: The date of the initial balance.

BankTransaction.title: BankTransaction
BankTransaction.description: Represents a single transaction for a bank account.

date.description: Date and time of the transaction.

amount.description: Amount of the transaction. Positive for income, negative for expense.

attachments.description: Array of evidence files attached to the transaction.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who created the project.

ProjectActivity.title: ProjectActivity
ProjectActivity.description: Represents a single activity or task within a project.

dependencyId.description: The ID of the activity that this one depends on.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent activity, if this is a sub-task.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to manage tasks and user profiles for the TaskMaster Pro application, prioritizing security, scalability, and debuggability. It emphasizes Authorization Independence by avoiding hierarchical authorization dependencies.

**Authorization Independence and QAPs:**

*   **User Profiles:** User profile data is stored under `/users/{userId}/profile`.  Authorization rules can directly check if `request.auth.uid == userId`. Segregation ensures only the user can access their profile.
*   **Tasks:** Tasks are stored within a user's document in the `/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}` collection. This structure ensures that only the authenticated user can access and manipulate tasks under their ownership. The structure allows for secure listing of tasks, as the query will be always be scoped to the user's own tasks, satisfying QAPs (Rules are not Filters) requirements.
* **Chats**: A top-level `/chats` collection stores conversation metadata. Each chat document contains an array `memberIds`. Security rules ensure only users whose UID is in `memberIds` can read/write to the chat document and its `messages` subcollection. This enforces privacy for 1-on-1 and group chats.

This structure promotes clarity of intent and supports robust security rules without relying on complex `get()` calls. The path-based ownership model provides inherent security and facilitates simple, efficient rules.
